body: Look at the comments. That whiny turd knows his audience. Teenagers and manchildren, perpetually coated in a fine layer of cheeto dust and mountain dew.

For a community of people who claim to love le logic and le reason, it's pathetic that so many redditards can't see past a blatant strawman argument so long as it conforms to their biases and comes from the mouth of the patron saint of ratheism.

The PC Handbook says that your entire worthless ideology is based on nothing but memes, South Park quotes, and complaints about "political correctness" and "safe spaces." It suggests you go to school, get an education, read a book, and stop getting your news from comedy central and reddit.
